Tuition and Financial Support
Ph.D. students in Chemical Engineering who are making acceptable progress toward degree
generally receive full support for their tuition and a stipend.
Sources of support may include research assistantships, teaching assistantships, and
fellowships.
USF offers multiple internal fellowships. Nomination deadlines for these fellowships
are generally in January and February, however, prospective students who wish to be
considered for these fellowships should submit their application by the preferred
Dec. 10 date.
In addition, we strongly encourage students to pursue external, nationally competitive
graduate fellowship opportunities.
Internal USF Fellowships open to incoming graduate students
The following internal USF fellowships offer multi-year full or substantial partial
fellowships to incoming Ph.D. students.
Presidential Doctoral Fellowship
Graduate Student Success Fellowship
Delores Auzenne Fellowship
